title: Template editor
intro: Change the look of your world and hear the result live. Nothing is saved until you save.
loadError: This template could not be opened. You can start from the default look instead.
name: Template name
rule.title: Rule {n}
rule.pitchHint: Examples: <48, >72 or 48-72. Empty matches every pitch.
rule.velocityHint: Examples: <0.4, >0.7 or 0.2-0.8. Empty matches every velocity.
rule.count: {count} of {max} rules. The first matching rule wins; the last one can match every note.
zone.title: Zone {n}
zone.none: No zone: every shape can appear on the whole plate.
error.contrast: The staff must stand out from the background.
error.name: Plain text only: no links or markup.
error.kind: Pick a built-in shape or a recipe of this template.
error.size: The template is larger than 32 KB.
error.zoneOrder: The minimum must be smaller than the maximum.
errorCount: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}
previewNote: The preview keeps the last valid version while there is a problem.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to save your template.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.TEMPLATE_INVALID: The server refused this template. Check the fields marked in the form.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_EDITABLE: A published template cannot be edited. Save a new draft instead.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: This draft no longer exists. Save it again to create a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many templates saved. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Try again.
recipe.none: No custom shape yet: only the built-in shapes are available.
recipe.name: Shape name
part.title: Part {n}
error.recipeName: Use 1 to 40 characters: a-z, 0-9 and _, different from the other shapes.
error.recipeBudget: The parts need more triangles than the budget allows.
inventory.title: Objects
parts.title: Parts
parts.noShape: This object has no editable shape (authored model or effect).
parts.stockNote: Built-in object: edit a copy as a recipe of this template.
inspector.title: Part: {name}
viewport.label: Object view: drag or use the arrow keys to turn around it
panel.label: Template editor panel
hint.terrain.style: Surface of the ground: cracked slabs or one smooth sheet.
hint.terrain.mountains: Hills drawn around the plate, or none for a flat horizon.
hint.terrain.size: Side of the square world, in metres. Bigger fits more objects but each looks smaller.
hint.staff.style: How the music staff is drawn: glowing lines, an aurora ribbon or a flowing current.
hint.staff.path: Shape of the staff across the world: a diagonal curve or a straight line.
hint.staff.clef: Show a treble clef at the start of the staff.
hint.staff.glow: Brightness of the staff. 0 is dim, 3 is very bright.
hint.staff.lookahead: How many seconds of music are visible ahead of the playing note.
hint.staff.fallDuration: Seconds a note takes to fall from the sky onto the staff.
hint.fx.particles: Small moving specks around the notes.
hint.fx.chordLinks: Draw a light arc between the notes of one chord.
hint.fx.material: Polished objects are lit and reflect the sky; flat ones are unlit and cheaper on a headset.
hint.fx.bloom: Soft halo around bright things. 0 is off, 2 is strong.
hint.fx.beatPulse: The world swells a little on every beat.
hint.palette.background: Colour of the sky and the far distance.
hint.palette.primary: Main colour of objects, used by most note rules.
hint.palette.accent: Highlight colour: bright notes, glow and details.
hint.palette.staff: Colour of the staff lines. It must stand out from the background.
material.title: Look of the part
material.colorHint: Multiplies the object’s own colour. White leaves it unchanged.
material.roleHint: Follows the template palette: change the palette and this part follows.
material.emissiveHint: 0 is normal, 1 makes the part about 60 % brighter, as if it emitted light.
material.roughnessHint: 0 is shiny like glass, 1 is matte like chalk. Needs the polished material (Effects). The object uses the average of its parts.
inspector.hint.position: Metres from the parent part (or from the object’s base). Y is up.
inspector.hint.size: Width, height and depth in the object’s own units (the whole object is rescaled to fit its footprint).
zone.intro: A zone is a rectangle of the ground where one shape is allowed to appear. A shape with no zone can appear anywhere on the plate; a shape with one or more zones appears only inside them. Use zones to keep trees on the edges, buildings in the middle, and so on.
zone.mapLabel: Top view of the plate with the zones drawn on it
zone.mapHelp: Top view of the plate. The camera looks from the bottom (near edge) toward the top (far edge).
zone.hint.xMin: Left limit. -1 is the left edge, 0 the centre, 1 the right edge.
zone.hint.xMax: Right limit, to the right of the left limit.
zone.hint.zMin: Far limit. -1 is the far edge (back of the scene), 0 the centre, 1 the near edge.
zone.hint.zMax: Near limit, nearer than the far limit.
zone.hint.kind: The shape this zone applies to. Only this shape is limited by the zone.
rule.hint.chord: Match only notes played inside a chord, only the others, or every note.
rule.hint.stem: The instrument the note comes from (the song is split into vocals, drums, bass and other).
rule.hint.spawn: What appears in the world for a note that matches this rule.
rule.hint.heightFrom: What makes the object taller: how hard the note is played, how long it lasts, or how high its pitch is.
rule.hint.colorRole: Colour taken from the palette, or a gradient that follows the pitch of the note.
recipe.hint.footprint: Side of the square the shape stands on, in metres. Wide shapes (a whale, a wreck) need more.
recipe.hint.heightScale: Below 1 the shape is squat, above 1 it is tall.
recipe.hint.budget: Maximum triangles of this shape. Lower is lighter on a headset; the shape is refused above it.
part.hint.op.prism: A rounded or pointed column (sides and taper).
part.hint.op.stack: Several floors piled up, each smaller than the last.
part.hint.op.cluster: A small group of copies around the centre.
part.hint.width: Left to right, as a share of the footprint.
part.hint.depth: Front to back, as a share of the footprint.
part.hint.height: Top to bottom, before the whole shape is rescaled.
part.hint.y: Height of the bottom of the part above the ground.
part.hint.sides: Number of sides of the column (3 is a triangle, 12 almost round).
part.hint.taper: Top width relative to the bottom: 1 straight, 0 ends in a point.
part.hint.levels: Number of floors in the stack.
part.hint.shrink: How much narrower each floor is than the one below.
part.hint.count: Number of copies in the group.
part.hint.spread: How far the copies are from the centre.
part.hint.seedOffset: Changes the heights and angles of the copies.
material.textureHint: A pattern drawn on the part, in metres, without any image file. It multiplies the colour. It shows in the world view, not in this small preview.
tools.bevelHint: Rounds off the edges of a box: 0 is sharp, 0.45 is very round. Costs 44 triangles instead of 12.
tools.operationHint: Merge welds this part to its parent and removes the faces hidden inside. Cut makes a hole in the parent with the shape of this part (a window or door). Only a part whose parent is a separate part can do this. Costs extra triangles.
tools.profileHint: Corners of the shape seen from above (x, z in the footprint, -0.5 to 0.5). It must be convex: no corner may point inward.
tools.profileNotConvex: This outline is not convex: it is not drawn until you fix it.
variants.title: Variants
variants.hint: Looks a placed object can pick by its variant number (1 is the first). Each has a height factor and a colour jitter range.
variants.name: Name
variants.heightHint: Share of the normal height (0.5 to 1.5).
variants.jitterHint: How much each copy's lightness may vary, up to ± this share (0 = none).
history.label: History
history.diff: Against the reference: {added} added, {removed} removed, {changed} changed parts; variants changed: {variants}.
error.drawCalls: Too many different shapes: the world would need more than 100 draw calls.
workspace.title: Editing {name}
workspace.noWebgl: The 3D viewport needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer.
workspace.addHint: Adds a part under the selected one.
workspace.noSelection: Click a part in the viewport or in the list to edit it.
workspace.status.hint: Drag to orbit · Shift+drag to box select · right drag to pan · wheel to zoom · ? for shortcuts
workspace.dragHint: Drag a part onto another to make it a child; drop on the empty area to make it a root.
inventory.engine.title: Added by the world
inventory.engine.badge: Built by the world, not editable here
inventory.engine.intro.city: The city builds these around your objects as the notes play. They are listed so you know what the world contains.
inventory.engine.intro.reef: The world grows these patches around your objects, following the layout. They are listed so you know what the world contains.
inventory.engine.badgeEditable: Built by the world. Edit it as a recipe to restyle it.
inventory.engine.control.terrain: Laid out by the city plan and coloured by the Terrain palette: not a shape, so change it in the template's palette and terrain settings.
inventory.engine.control.layout: Placed by the world layout around your objects: not a shape, so change it through the objects above and the layout.
